title: Billy and the Lost Colors
moral: With bravery and kindness, problems can be solved.

scenes.summary: Billy lives on a colorful ranch and meets Mr. Hanks who needs help.
scenes.text: In the wide sunny land of the West there lived a young cowboy named Billy. Billy wore a big brown hat and shiny boots. He lived on a bright colorful ranch with friendly horses and cows. One day Mr. Hanks came to Billy and said the colors of the ranch were gone.
scenes.image_prompt: young cowboy boy on colorful ranch with animals and smiling farmer, bright cartoon children's book style
scenes.story: In the wide sunny land of the West there lived a young cowboy named Billy. Billy wore a big brown hat and shiny boots. He lived on a bright colorful ranch with friendly horses and cows. One day Mr Hanks came to Billy and said the colors of the ranch were gone. Billy said he would find the colors. He rode his horse Dusty across green fields and saw a rainbow. He met a kind fox who told him to follow the breeze. Billy followed the wind through yellow fields and found the Wind playing. The Wind said it had borrowed the colors but would give them back. The colors returned to the ranch. Billy rode back and everyone cheered. That night Billy and Dusty rested under the stars and were happy.
